# DataLab Tasks

The DataLab Tasks are the applied component of the course. You will use the concepts introduced in the self-study material to solve a real machine-learning problem.

The machine-learning part of the DataLab follows an **iterative CRISP-DM workflow**. Tasks are therefore not simply completed once from Task 1 to Task 7. Instead, you will revisit different parts of the workflow as your understanding of the data and models develops.

## Iterations

### [Iteration 1 — First ML Cycle](iteration-1/index.qmd)

Go through the complete machine-learning workflow for the first time and build your first classification, regression, and clustering models.
